changelog: Fix Kaggle LoRA training data path for good. A sibling dataset.jsonl is never uploaded by kaggle kernels push, and embedding the pool inside the runner exceeds Kaggle's 1 MB notebook source limit (the SaveKernel API answered 400 Bad Request), so each run still trained on six seed samples. The workflow now publishes the verified pool as a private Kaggle Dataset and attaches it through dataset_sources, the runner loads it from /kaggle/input/, and the job refuses to launch a training run when no dataset was published or it never became ready. Previous release: embedded the dataset in the runner script.
